svg.text: From observed nodes to bilateral order.
Three layouts after Tony Oursler. Manual traces and design derivatives; not recognition models.
Solid: traced structure. Grey dash: uncertain / occluded. Orange dash: added for bilateral symmetry.
Reference artworks © Tony Oursler. Artist archive: tonyoursler.com/templatevariantfriendstranger-london
Red and blue are descriptive labels. Blue mask belongs to the parallel panel series in the same 2015 exhibition.
